scalars.scalar_value: EXPERIENCE: Three years of experience related to the duties of the position.

items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet minimum qualifications for the Instructional Services Assistant II position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. One year of education is equal to 30 semester units. Options: I have three (3) or more years of full-time experience related to the duties of the position, and two (2) years of college level business, office technology, or related course work from an accredited institution. | Promotional: One (1) year of experience as an Instructional Services Assistant I in the Los Rios Community College District, and two (2) years of college level business, office technology, or related course work from an accredited institution. | I do not meet the minimum qualifications.
EXPERIENCE: Three years of experience related to the duties of the position.

Promotional : One year of experience as an Instructional Services Assistant I in the Los Rios Community College District; AND , Two years of college level business, office technology, or related course work from an accredited institution. (Promotional applies to current, regular Classified employees working with the Los Rios Community College District.)

( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.)
EDUCATION: Two years of college level business, office technology, or related course work from an accredited institution.
Education must be from an accredited institution.

Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment.
